breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: Dirichlet (u=0) and periodic. The ground truth resolved this by keeping only the Dirichlet condition. The agent correctly identified this conflict and generated a specification that only includes the Dirichlet condition ('with Dirichlet boundary conditions u=0 on all four edges'), successfully resolving the inconsistency.
